dialogue_messages.content: I am not in real distress, but my breathing has felt a little uncomfortable recently, especially when I walk upstairs.
Do you have chest pain, fever, dizziness, shortness of breath at rest, or a new cough?
No chest pain or fever. I can breathe normally when sitting, but I have a small dry cough and get tired faster than usual.
Have you checked oxygen levels, and is this different from your usual breathing before the ADC infusion?
My oxygen is around 95 today. It is usually closer to 98. It is not dramatic, just different.

patient.chief_complaint: I am not in real distress, but my breathing has felt a little uncomfortable recently, especially when I walk upstairs.

diagnoses: Metastatic NSCLC (EGFR exon 19 del)（Metastatic non-small cell lung cancer; EGFR exon 19 deletion）
Prior platinum chemotherapy; reduced respiratory reserve
medical_history.diagnoses_str: Metastatic NSCLC (EGFR exon 19 del)（Metastatic non-small cell lung cancer; EGFR exon 19 deletion）、Prior platinum chemotherapy; reduced respiratory reserve

scenario.chief_complaint: Exertional dyspnea with dry cough and SpO2 drift
scenario.initial_query: I am not in real distress, but my breathing has felt a little uncomfortable recently, especially when I walk upstairs.

signals_list.summary_text: Mild HR drift and SpO2 below baseline in the early ADC-047 exposure window; respiratory self-report.

signals.summary_text: Mild HR drift and SpO2 below baseline in the early ADC-047 exposure window; respiratory self-report.

advice: Treat as an early ADC-047 respiratory toxicity signal in a patient with reduced pulmonary reserve, not simple deconditioning
Collect daily resting + post-activity SpO2, HR, temperature, cough frequency and walking tolerance
On progression order chest HRCT (preferred ILD imaging), CBC for anemia, and ECG/BNP if cardiac is suspected
If findings suggest suspected >=G3 ILD, hold the next dose and arrange emergent evaluation
Check resting and post-activity SpO2, heart rate and temperature daily
Note any change in cough frequency and walking tolerance
Contact the trial team immediately if SpO2 falls below 92%, you become short of breath at rest, develop fever, or have chest pain

symptoms.chief_complaint: I am not in real distress, but my breathing has felt a little uncomfortable recently, especially when I walk upstairs.
patient_feedback: My oxygen is around 95 today, usually closer to 98; I have a small dry cough and get tired faster than usual.
raw_patient_feedback: My oxygen is around 95 today, usually closer to 98; I have a small dry cough and get tired faster than usual.

likely_causes: Early drug-induced ILD / pneumonitis (DXd-class signature DLT)
triage.rationale: Stable now; complaint could be baseline lung cancer / deconditioning / treatment fatigue, but it sits in the early ADC exposure window, so a small respiratory change may precede a toxicity pattern.

onset.en: New, insidious-onset exertional dyspnea with a dry cough emerging in the early ADC-047 exposure window (C1D15).
onset.zh: 在 ADC-047 早期暴露窗(C1D15)出现新发、隐匿起病的活动后气短伴干咳。

escalation.en: A second comparable respiratory signal within the lung axis triggers a PI safety review plus a protocol-permitted dose hold for that subgroup.
escalation.zh: 肺轴内出现第二个可比呼吸信号即触发 PI 安全审查并对该子群启动协议允许的剂量暂停。

intro.en: Within 15 days of ADC-047 dosing, Jason is one of 3 cycle-1 signals across the 8-person cohort and occupies the lung-reserve axis. Of the 8 on ADC-047, 3 are symptomatic (Jason / Emily / Michael, three different organ systems) and 5 are asymptomatic. The 5 are stratified by axis; those with reduced lung reserve (prior thoracic radiation / low baseline DLCO) are the subgroup most likely to reproduce Jason's ILD signal next cycle.
intro.zh: 在 ADC-047 给药 15 天内,Jason 是 8 人队列中 3 个第 1 周期信号之一,占据肺储备轴。8 名用药者中 3 名有症状(Jason / Emily / Michael,三个不同器官系统),5 名无症状。这 5 名按轴分层;呼吸储备下降者(既往胸部放疗 / 基线 DLCO 偏低)是最可能在下一周期复现 Jason ILD 信号的子群。

title.zh: 同药受试者易感子群推断

traits.en: reduced pulmonary reserve (metastatic NSCLC, age 72, prior platinum)
traits.zh: 肺储备下降(转移性 NSCLC、72 岁、既往含铂化疗)

organ_toxicity.zh: GI 毒性 + 脱水/血糖失稳

traits.en: type 2 diabetes; reduced metabolic reserve and poor oral intake
traits.zh: 2 型糖尿病;代谢储备下降、进食减少

organ_toxicity.zh: 心脏信号 (LVEF / QTc / 心律)

traits.en: prior CAD, hypertension, low-normal baseline LVEF
traits.zh: 既往冠心病、高血压、基线 LVEF 低限

watch_list.en: Build a respiratory watch-list for the lung-axis subgroup using the same questions used with Jason.
watch_list.zh: 用与 Jason 相同的问询为肺轴子群建立呼吸监测清单。

watch_list.en: Check baseline HRCT/DLCO, prior thoracic radiation, and renal function (DXd clearance).
watch_list.zh: 检查基线 HRCT/DLCO、既往胸部放疗及肾功能(DXd 清除)。

inference.en: Typical insidious onset of G1 drug-induced ILD (compensated at rest); past the 'watch only' threshold.
inference.zh: G1 药物相关 ILD 的典型隐匿起病(静息时代偿);已超过'仅观察'阈值。

observation.en: New exertional dyspnea + dry cough + SpO2 98 to 95, no fever, no resting dyspnea
observation.zh: 新发活动后气短 + 干咳 + 血氧 98 至 95,无发热,无静息气短

inference.en: Respiratory reserve already reduced, so equivalent injury becomes symptomatic and decompensates earlier; shorter warning window.
inference.zh: 呼吸储备已下降,同等损伤会更早出现症状并失代偿;预警窗口更短。

observation.en: Metastatic NSCLC + older age + prior platinum chemotherapy
observation.zh: 转移性 NSCLC + 高龄 + 既往含铂化疗

inference.en: Tumor progression, infection, anemia, cardiac cause.
inference.zh: 肿瘤进展、感染、贫血、心源性因素。

intro.en: Exertional dyspnea + dry cough + SpO2 98 to 95 is not acutely unstable, but matches the insidious onset of the DXd-class signature DLT (drug-induced ILD/pneumonitis); reduced respiratory reserve (metastatic NSCLC, age 72, prior platinum) shortens his warning window, so treat it as an early toxicity signal to actively track, not simple deconditioning.
intro.zh: 活动后气短 + 干咳 + 血氧 98 至 95 并非急性失稳,但符合 DXd 类标志性 DLT(药物相关 ILD/肺炎)的隐匿起病;呼吸储备下降(转移性 NSCLC、72 岁、既往含铂化疗)缩短了他的预警窗口,因此应作为需主动追踪的早期毒性信号,而非单纯的体能下降。

projection_48_72h.en: Benign course: SpO2 stable, walking tolerance returns, cough/fatigue do not progress.
projection_48_72h.zh: 良性病程:血氧稳定,步行耐量恢复,咳嗽/乏力不进展。

projection_48_72h.en: ADC-ILD progression: resting/exertional SpO2 keeps falling, dry cough worsens, fever, dyspnea shifts to rest, HRCT shows ground-glass opacities. Manage on this assumption until excluded.
projection_48_72h.zh: ADC-ILD 进展:静息/活动后血氧持续下降,干咳加重,出现发热,气短转为静息性,HRCT 出现磨玻璃影。在排除前按此假设管理。

patient.en: SpO2 < 92%, resting dyspnea, fever, or chest pain - contact the trial team immediately.
patient.zh: 血氧 < 92%、静息气短、发热或胸痛 — 立即联系试验团队。

physician.en: Treat as suspected >=G3 ILD: hold the next dose and arrange emergent evaluation.
physician.zh: 按疑似 >=G3 ILD 处理:暂停下一剂量并安排紧急评估。

surveillance.en: Daily resting + post-activity SpO2, HR, temperature, cough frequency, walking tolerance.
surveillance.zh: 每日静息 + 活动后血氧、心率、体温、咳嗽频率、步行耐量。

surveillance.en: On progression: chest HRCT (preferred ILD imaging), CBC for anemia, ECG/BNP if cardiac suspected.
surveillance.zh: 进展时:胸部 HRCT(首选 ILD 影像)、CBC 查贫血、疑心源性时 ECG/BNP。

title.zh: 潜在 ILD 轨迹推断

relevance.en: Establishes the patient's normal so the 98 to 95 SpO2 drift reads as a real change.
relevance.zh: 确立患者基线,使 98 至 95 的血氧漂移可被判读为真实变化。

content.zh: 转移性非小细胞肺癌,EGFR exon 19 缺失

relevance.en: Defines the lung-reserve vulnerability axis underlying the ILD projection.
relevance.zh: 定义 ILD 推断所依据的肺储备易感轴。

relevance.en: Prior platinum further reduces respiratory reserve and shortens the warning window.
relevance.zh: 既往含铂化疗进一步降低呼吸储备并缩短预警窗口。

content.en: reduced DLCO / baseline chest imaging on file
content.zh: DLCO 下降 / 已有基线胸部影像

relevance.en: Provides the imaging/diffusion baseline against which progression is judged.
relevance.zh: 提供判断进展所依据的影像/弥散基线。

content.zh: 本周期首次呼吸相关自述

relevance.en: Marks the signal as new this cycle, not a chronic baseline complaint.
relevance.zh: 标记该信号为本周期新发,而非慢性基线主诉。

context_text.en: ADC-047 Phase 1b multi-tumor safety cohort: a small early-phase basket across HER2/EGFR-altered solid tumors. 8 participants are currently on ADC-047; 3 are now symptomatic in cycle 1. Drug-induced ILD / pneumonitis is the signature dose-limiting toxicity of the DXd class and is watched for in every participant.
context_text.zh: ADC-047 1b 期多瘤种安全队列:针对 HER2/EGFR 改变实体瘤的早期小型篮式队列。目前 8 名受试者在用 ADC-047,其中 3 名在第 1 周期已出现症状。药物相关 ILD / 肺炎是 DXd 类的标志性剂量限制毒性,需在每位受试者中监测。

drug_class.zh: deruxtecan 类 ADC（topoisomerase-I 载荷，DXd 类）
